overview: This Senate resolution honors Hunter Simoncic, a Kansas City, Kansas police officer who was killed on duty on August 26, 2025, when a driver fleeing police struck him as he tried to stop the vehicle. It describes his upbringing in Galesburg, Kansas, his training, and his volunteer work as a Big Brothers Big Sisters mentor. The Senate offers condolences to his family, pays tribute to his sacrifice, and calls on all levels of government to support the families of fallen officers like him. It was approved on March 21, 2026.
for: Supporters say the resolution rightly honors an officer who died protecting his community and recognizes his family's loss.
against: Critics say it is symbolic and doesn't change any law or spending.
